description: Source code for pattern conversion in Torch JIT, specifically converting inplace index operations to ONNX format, including functions for handling tensor slicing, selecting, and index manipulation.

classes.name: ConvertedIndex
classes.description: Struct representing an index tensor and its original node kind (slice, select, index).

methods.name: CreateSizeOfDim
methods.description: Creates a size tensor for a specific dimension of an input tensor.

methods.name: ConvertSelectToIndex
methods.description: Converts an aten::select node to an index tensor by unsqueezing.

methods.name: ConvertSliceToIndex
methods.description: Converts an aten::slice node to an index tensor using arange and slice.

methods.name: MergeSliceAndSelectToIndices
methods.description: Merges slice and select nodes into a map of dimension indices.

methods.name: ReshapeToAdvancedIndexingFormat
methods.description: Reshapes index tensors for advanced indexing, adding view operations as needed.

methods.name: ConvertIndexPutToONNX
methods.description: Converts aten::index_put operations with slice/select patterns to ONNX format, replacing nodes accordingly.
